description: SportIQ (Live sports analysis and data + betting odds)plugs 48 live sports tools into any AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor): FIFA World Cup 2026 football, Formula 1, and IPL cricket. Ask in plain English — it simulates brackets, finds value bets, optimizes Dream11 teams, and models F1 pit strategy. Free, open-source, installs in seconds via uvx.
